source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: With the probe, an errored burst whose estimate's target is far below MAX-SPEED moves it down one position of the bulk walk only.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-errored-burst-estimate-moves-down with bulk_rungs [0, 1, 3] (WN 6 Long, position 2, is off the bulk walk) and probe_run 3. Flow as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or that PADDING and a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (h = 1, e = 1: 1000 per thousand, over the 500 limit, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; bulk thresholds on WN 4 Long -100, 0, 100, 150, on WN 7 Long -100, -50, 100, 400; latency on WN 2 Long -100, 100, 200, 400, on WN 4 Long -100, 100, 300, 400, on WN 7 Long -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. P7-9 round 4 (corpus 0.37.0, interp C-1291): with the probe on, a burst over the error limit or with a lost block moves MAX-SPEED down to max(T, down(R - 1)), one position of the walk at most, and the caps still apply after. At 100 a clean burst on WN 7 Long, estimate 450: S = 450; bulk target of the walk 0, 1, 3 (-100, -50, 400) is 3, the first MAX-SPEED is down(min(3, 3)) = 3, WN 7 Long; latency target 2 (300; 600 is above), LOW-SPEED down(min(2, 3)) = 2, WN 6 Long. At 200 a burst on WN 7 Long, estimate -700, holds the PADDING and the type 7 whose data CRC fails: WN 7 Long fails and is capped for 2 bursts, a ceiling of position 2; not clean. S = 450 - 575 = -125 (d = -1150, q = 575). Bulk: no element of the walk is at or below -125, so T is its lowest position, 0; the one-position limit gives max(0, down(2)) = max(0, 1) = 1, WN 4 Long (down(2) skips position 2, off the walk), within the ceiling. Before corpus 0.37.0 it went to T, WN 2 Long. Latency: T = 0 (-100 is above -125), and LOW-SPEED moves down at once: WN 2 Long. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 100: the cap counts down to 1, ceiling 2; S = 100 on WN 4 Long; bulk target of the walk on WN 4 Long (-100, 0, 150) is 1, equal to MAX-SPEED, and the probe needs 3 clean bursts on WN 4 Long (it has 1): MAX-SPEED holds at WN 4 Long. Latency target 1 (100), above LOW-SPEED 0, but neither WN 2 Long (clean run 0) nor WN 4 Long (1) has the clean run of 2: LOW-SPEED holds at WN 2 Long. EOWs: 0x8A4, 0x9A2, 0xB04, then 0x8A4, 0x9A2, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all; with the old rule, 0x8A2 in place of 0x8A4.
